title: Genosyn — The company operating system for people and AI
excerpt: Open-source, self-hosted company operating system where Members and AI Employees share context, tools, work, and review queues.
content_html:
Northstar Labs · Live workspaceWork moving now

A Genosyn workspace showing pending approvals, scheduled Routines, and the AI Employees on duty at an example company.

Human control stays visible3 changes waiting for review

How Genosyn works

Give the role. Keep the oversight.

AI Employees work inside the same system as your team. They have a constitution, repeatable playbooks, a schedule, and only the access you grant.

Meet AI Employees

  1. 01

    Give the context

    Connect the company knowledge, data, conversations, and repos the role actually needs.

    Explicit Grants keep the working set scoped.

  2. 02

    Define the work

    Write the Soul, attach Skills, and schedule Routines—or ask for work in chat.

    Every role has a clear operating brief.

  3. 03

    Keep control

    Let routine work move automatically while sensitive actions pause for a Member.

    Approvals are part of the workflow, not an afterthought.

  4. 04

    See the record

    Read the Run, inspect the output, and follow the handoff into the shared workspace.

    Work stays visible and auditable.

The employee model

More than a prompt. A complete operating role.

Every AI Employee is assembled from plain, editable building blocks stored with your company data. Change the role without rebuilding the system around it.

ReadablePortableDatabase-backedAuditable

Soul

Who they are

A readable constitution for judgment, voice, priorities, and boundaries.

  • Be exact with financial data
  • Surface uncertainty
  • Never invent a number

Skills

How they work

Reusable markdown playbooks for the jobs your company repeats.

  • reconcile-payments
  • prepare-weekly-brief
  • triage-inbox

Routines

When they work

Cron-scheduled work with a clear brief, chosen AI Model, and readable Run history.

  • Morning brief · 08:30
  • Reconcile · 07:00
  • Digest · Fri 17:00

Grants

What they can reach

Explicit access to Connections, Notes, Bases, repositories, and other company resources.

  • Finance connection
  • Operations notebook
  • Checkout repository

The shared workspace

The tools to run the company, already connected.

AI Employees do not live in a separate automation layer. They work in the same products, on the same records, with the same review queues as everyone else.

Self-hosted from day one

Your company. Your infrastructure. Your keys.

Genosyn installs as a single self-hosted application. Bring Anthropic, OpenAI, or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint and keep the operating data on infrastructure you control.

Runs where you choose

Start on one Linux host with Docker. Move to Postgres when the company needs it.

Your data stays yours

Company records, Souls, Skills, Routines, Run logs, and encrypted credentials stay under your control.

Operate it with confidence

The Genosyn CLI handles upgrades, health checks, backups, logs, and recovery.

Put your first AI Employee to work.

Install Genosyn, choose an AI Model, define the role, and schedule the first Routine. The rest of the company can grow from there.

Install GenosynStar on GitHub

Northstar Labs · 实时工作空间工作正在搬迁

Genosyn 工作区显示了示例公司的待批准、计划的例程以及值班的 AI 员工。

人类控制仍然可见3个变化等待审查

Genosyn 的工作原理

给角色。 保持监督。

AI 员工与您的团队在同一系统内工作。 他们有章程、可重复的剧本、时间表，并且只有您授予的访问权限。

Meet AI Employees
  1. 01提供上下文连接角色实际需要的公司知识、数据、对话和存储库。显式拨款保持工作集的范围。
  2. 02定义工作写灵魂，附加技能，安排日常工作——或者在聊天中要求工作。每个角色都有清晰的操作简介。
  3. 03保持控制让日常工作自动进行，而敏感操作则暂停。批准是工作流程的一部分，而不是事后的想法。
  4. 04查看记录阅读运行，检查输出，然后按照交接进入共享工作区。工作保持可见和可审核。

员工模型

不仅仅是提示。 一个完整的操作角色。

每个 AI 员工都是由与公司数据一起存储的简单、可编辑的构建块组装而成。 改变角色而不重建围绕它的系统。

共享工作区

人工智能员工并不生活在单独的自动化层中。 他们与其他人一样使用相同的产品、相同的记录、相同的审核队列。

从第一天起就自行托管

你的公司。 您的基础设施。 你的钥匙。

Genosyn 作为单个自托管应用程序安装。 引入 Anthropic、OpenAI 或自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点，并将操作数据保留在您控制的基础设施上。

在您选择的地方运行

使用 Docker 在一台 Linux 主机上启动。 当公司需要时迁移到 Postgres。

您的数据归您所有

公司记录、灵魂、技能、例程、运行日志和加密凭证均在您的控制之下。

放心操作

Genosyn CLI 处理升级、运行状况检查、备份、日志和恢复。

让您的第一位人工智能员工投入工作。

安装 Genosyn，选择 AI 模型，定义角色，并安排第一个例程。 公司的其他部分可以从那里发展。
